arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made on a card whose type is prepaid debit, so any purchase paid with a prepaid debit card is caught.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit card' is read as card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'. Plain 'Debit' and 'Credit' cards are not included.
